lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron the Israelites may eat any animal with a split hoof that chews the cud.
The camel, the rock badger and the rabbit chew the cud but have no divided hoof, so they are unclean.
Of the creatures in the water, the Israelites may eat anything with paws and scales.
Israel may eat locusts, katydids, crickets and grasshoppers, which have jointed legs for digging on the ground.
The LORD tells the Israelites to be holy because He is holy, and He brought them up out of Egypt.
